messages:
Maya Patel: quick sync on Kairos onboarding perf — we're seeing nightly import latency spikes. p99 up ~1.2s during heavy backfills.
Priya Rao: thanks Maya. do you have traces? looks like a few very long sequences driving the tail.
Maya Patel: attached a short trace snippet below. most requests ~2-3k tokens but intermittent 8-12k. KV cache hit-rate ok except during their bulk backfills.
Liam Chen: tagging infra folks. @Priya any low-risk mitigations we can roll without model retraining?
Priya Rao: two pragmatic moves: 1) serve that import route with an int8 quant profile to reduce latency and mem pressure; 2) route heavy long-context imports to a dedicated pool using gptx-medium while keeping interactive traffic on gptx-large.
Maya Patel: proposed plan: enable int8 profile + add a time-windowed route: imports -> kairos-dedicated between 02:00-06:00 local, fallback to hosted if pool saturated.
Liam Chen: add autoscale: pre-spin 2 GPUs 15m before the window so first bursts don't cold-start. I can configure that.
Maya Patel: can someone draft the exact routing snippet I can paste into Console for the enablement call?
Priya Rao: here's a handy snippet you can paste into Console -> Routes:
```json
{"match":{"path":"/v1/generate","meta.user_role":"importer"},"route":{"pool":"kairos-dedicated","time_window":"02:00-06:00","fallback":"hosted-us"},"transform":{"model_override":"gptx-medium","quant_profile":"int8-stable"}}
```
Maya Patel: perfect. I'll share with Kairos in tomorrow's call. also flagging renewal risk: they care about predictable latency for SLA. if unresolved they may push on renewal. adding as an enablement & AM note.
Evan Gold: (Kairos) saw this, appreciate the proactive ops. int8 is fine if output quality stays consistent. can we run a small test before full rollout? :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: yes — recommend a canary: 5% of import traffic to int8 + gptx-medium for 24h. measure latency, cost delta, and run a short quality eval (~5k examples).
Liam Chen: I'll implement the pre-spin autoscale and cap burst concurrency to avoid noisy neighbors.
Maya Patel: ops-bot 1 create follow-up task and attach the perf dashboard for Kairos imports
ops-bot: Task created: CS-2357 "Kairos import routing + int8 canary" 1 https://console.redwood.ai/tasks/CS-2357. Dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/kairos-imports
Maya Patel: next steps: (1) Priya publishes draft route + quant profile (2) Liam sets autoscale/pre-spin and burst caps (3) run 5% canary for 24h and collect metrics + eval (4) enablement call tomorrow 11:00 PT to review and get customer sign-off.
Evan Gold: 11:00 PT works for us; our data engineer will join.
Priya Rao: dropping draft route in shared doc and flagging for review.
Maya Patel: adding this as a proactive perf rec in their account playbook and marking a renewal note so AMs see it's being handled. will report back after 24h canary. :white_check_mark:
Evan Gold: thanks team, that gives us confidence about renewal.
Maya Patel: I'll post results here after the canary completes.
